verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents an official CLI for managing subscribers, campaigns and automations from the terminal. It also offers a REST API with official SDKs, and API keys designed for machine-to-machine authentication with no human input after setup, which together support headless, scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline usage guidance or examples, documented non-interactive CLI behaviour (such as env-var auth or exit codes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Install and use the MailerLite CLI to manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal.
API keys are a quick way to implement machine-to-machine authentication without any direct inputs from a human beyond initial setup.
Push or pull data from our RESTful API.
Draft, schedule, send, and cancel email campaigns, plus retrieve campaign reports and link clicks.
